missed.why: A family P2 did not consider: the BQ2572x NVDC buck-boost chargers. Data sheet SLUSE64, May 2021 (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/bq25723.pdf, read 2026-09-29T12:25:56Z). Features: 'Pin-to-pin compatible to BQ25713'. Input range 3.5 to 26 V; VBUS recommended 0 to 26 V, absolute maximum 32 V. Charges 1S to 4S; CELL_BATPRESZ sets a 2S default of 8400 mV. ChargeVoltage LSB is 8 mV. With a 10 mOhm sense resistor, charge current reaches 8.1 A in 64 mA steps, which covers 2.35 A. Input limit: IIN_HOST in 50 mA steps with 10 mOhm, and ILIM_HIZ = 1 V + 40 x IDPM x RAC. With EN_EXTILIM = 1, the lower of pin and register applies. IIN_DPM accuracy with 10 mOhm (section 8.5): 0x3A00 gives 2800 to 3000 mA, 0x1C00 gives 1300 to 1500 mA, 0x0800 gives 300 to 500 mA, so 3.0, 1.5 and 0.5 A hold without exceeding them. The ILIM_HIZ pin at 1.2 V gives 300 to 700 mA, so a pin-set 500 mA limit can exceed 500 mA. The host terminates charge with CHRG_INHIBIT or ChargeCurrent = 0 (9.4.1.2), on the SRP/SRN cell-side current. BATFET power path: Yes (Device Comparison Table). Recommended TJ is -20 to 125 degC. It reads no NTC; the pack protection reads it. Firmware dependence is as for the BQ25713: the watchdog defaults to 175 s at POR, and a timeout clears ChargeCurrent (9.3.22.1). It uses I2C at 6Bh, the BQ25713's address. The comparison table shows other differences from the BQ25713: 5/10 mOhm sensing where the BQ25713 uses 10/20 mOhm, a programmable VSYS_UVP, and frequency dithering. Register identity with the BQ25713 was not checked, so it is not qualified as the rule-5 firmware-identical alternate. Figures: JLCPCB exact match C2871889 stockCount 214, canPresaleNumber 213, expand (2026-09-29T12:25:38Z). TI https://www.ti.com/product/BQ25723 meta status ACTIVE (12:29:50Z). Digi-Key (https://api.digikey.com/products/v4/search/BQ25723RSNR/productdetails, 12:35:00Z): 4528 cut tape and 3000 tape and reel, Active, 16 weeks. The TI product page links TRM SLUUC74 (not read). Other boost-capable chargers found in jlcparts that fail rule 4 at JLCPCB (exact matches, 12:25:38Z to 12:25:42Z): BQ25720RSNR C2870152 (0, presale -2), BQ25770GREER C35890629 (10), BQ25773REER C42047770 (20), BQ25750RRVR C22427288 (0, presale -9), BQ25708RSNR C2876359 (2), MAX77962EWJ06+T C3682879 (0), ISL9241IRTZ C5657483 (10), ISL9238HRTZ-T C3682822 (20), LTC4000IGN#PBF C687096 (5). BQ25820RRVR (C41809860, 219) is a buck controller (SLUSFN3A title, read 12:25:57Z), so it cannot charge 8.4 V from 5 V. BQ25756RRVR (C19272232, 9120) is a buck-boost charger with no system node or BATFET (SLUSEN5A, read 12:25:58Z), so it does not give the VSYS of the floor-disconnect value.

It has the same NVDC power path as P2's rank 1. SLUSE64 (read 2026-09-29T12:25:56Z) section 5: 'The system keeps operating even when the battery is completely discharged or removed', and in supplement mode the battery supports the system. This covers V152's USB-only operation and running from the pack while charging. The external P-channel BATFET on BATDRV carries the pack current, so it is sized for 12.23 A as on the BQ25713. The SRP/SRN charge-current sense sits between the BATFET and the cells, so termination follows the cells' current. SRP-SRN is rated -0.5 to 0.5 V; 12.23 A in 10 mOhm is 122 mV (computed). Device Comparison Table: 'BATFET Power Path Yes'. JLCPCB 214, presale 213 (12:25:38Z). TI ACTIVE (12:29:50Z). Digi-Key 4528, Active, 16 weeks (12:35:00Z).

A family P2 did not consider: the BQ40Zxx/BQ4050 1S to 4S pack managers. Data sheet SLUSCS4C, June 2017, revised April 2021 (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/bq40z50-r2.pdf, read 2026-09-29T12:37:37Z); TRM SLUUBK0B (https://www.ti.com/lit/ug/sluubk0b/sluubk0b.pdf, read 12:30:13Z). VCC (BAT, VCC, PBI) is 2.2 to 26 V. 2S configuration: VC4 shorted to VC3 and VC2. TOPR is -40 to 85 degC. It drives high-side N-channel CHG and DSG FETs, so the pack's negative stays on board ground. Discharge overcurrent: OCD1 threshold -32768 to 32767 mA in data flash (TRM 15.9.7), and the AFE OLD is 8.3 to 50 mV with RSNS = 0. Short circuit: AFE SCD1 is 22.2 to 100 mV in 11.1 mV steps with RSNS = 0, offset +-2.5 mV, scale error +-5 % post-trim (7.31). Computed for a 2 mOhm resistor: a 55.5 mV setting is 27.75 A nominal and 25.1 to 30.4 A with tolerance, which is at or under 35 A and above 12.23 A. Cell overvoltage: COV thresholds 0 to 32767 mV (TRM 15.9.3), so 4250 mV can be set. OTC and OTD thresholds are -40.0 to 150.0 degC (defaults 55.0 and 60.0). UTC is -40.0 to 150.0 degC (default 0.0 degC) and blocks charge below it (TRM 15.9.13, 15.9.14, 15.9.16). TS1 to TS4 have an 18 kOhm pull-up for a 10 kOhm (103) NTC; the data sheet names the Mitsubishi BN35-3H103. The Cell Temp Model coefficients a1 to a5, b1 to b4, Rc0 and Adc0 are data flash (TRM 12.2.1.8), so the pack's B 3435 K NTC is modelled by writing them. The coefficient values were not computed. It protects from data flash with no host writes. JLCPCB exact match C2845123 stockCount 9979, canPresaleNumber 9881, expand (12:28:59Z). TI https://www.ti.com/product/BQ40Z50-R2 meta status ACTIVE (12:29:49Z). Digi-Key (12:35:02Z): 166 cut tape and 0 tape and reel, Active, 16 weeks. The BQ40Z50RSMR-R1 (C179743) has the same AFE (SLUSCB3 7.31, read 12:27:37Z). JLCPCB: 20579, presale 20553 (12:28:59Z). TI meta status is ACTIVE (12:29:49Z), but Digi-Key reads 'Not For New Designs' (12:35:04Z, 5933 in stock); the manufacturer's status counts, and the disagreement is recorded here. Same family, found and not qualified here: BQ4050RSMR C157570 (15945 at 12:29:00Z; CEDV gauge, SLUSC67B, TI ACTIVE 12:29:50Z) and BQ40Z80RSMR C882850 (8611 at 12:28:59Z; 2S to 6S, VCC 2.2 to 32 V, SLUSBV4D, TI ACTIVE 12:29:50Z).

It balances on its own from data flash, while charging and at rest (TRM SLUUBK0B chapter 7, read 2026-09-29T12:30:13Z). Internal bypass: 'up to 10 mA' (SLUSCS4C 9.3.5.5, read 12:37:37Z), under 43 mA. External mode: Balancing Configuration[CBM] = 1 balances one cell at a time (TRM 7.3). In a 2S pack only the higher cell is bypassed, so rotation costs nothing. The data sheet refers to 'Fast Cell Balancing Using External MOSFET', SLUA420A (https://www.ti.com/lit/an/slua420a/slua420a.pdf, read 12:29:12Z). Its 2-cell circuit, a dual N-FET with a 50 Ohm resistor and 1 kOhm VCx filter resistors, bypasses 65 mA at 3.6 V. That note measured the circuit on a bq29330 AFE and bq20z70 firmware, not on this part. The bypass current is therefore set by the chosen FET and resistor, as for P2's rank 2 BQ29209. The balancing duty on this part is not stated beyond 'Cell balancing is paused during OCV measurement' (TRM 7.4), so the 43 mA average of V142 is met only if the resistor is sized with margin for that duty. VCC 2.2 to 26 V covers 6.0 to 8.4504 V. TOPR is -40 to 85 degC. It does not depend on the charger. It is the same part as the Pack overcurrent protection entry, so one part covers protection, NTC and balancing, as MAX17320G22+ does. JLCPCB 9979, presale 9881 (12:28:59Z). TI ACTIVE (12:29:49Z). Digi-Key 166, Active, 16 weeks (12:35:02Z).

The 3-conductor 2S lead ends at this part. SLUSCS4C (read 2026-09-29T12:37:37Z) pin table and 9.3.5.4 give: VC1 is the least positive cell's sense and balance input (mid-point tap), VC2 to VC4 are shorted together to the pack top in the 2S configuration, and VSS is the negative. Its CHG and DSG FETs are high-side, so the lead's bottom tap stays on board ground when they open. The connector is round 2. JLCPCB 9979 (12:28:59Z); TI ACTIVE (12:29:49Z); Digi-Key 166, Active (12:35:02Z).

A family P2 did not consider: the TCPC PHY. Data sheet PTN5110 Rev. 1.6, 3 April 2020 (https://www.nxp.com/docs/en/data-sheet/PTN5110.pdf, read 2026-09-29T12:34:31Z). It 'implements Type-C CC analog portion (i.e Rd/Rp/Ra detection, Rd/Rp indication)'. Sink thresholds are VTUS 0.61/0.66/0.70 V (standard current) and VTUM 1.16/1.23/1.31 V (medium current), which separate Default, 1.5 A and 3.0 A. It 'implements SNK role pull-down (Rd) behavior to handle dead battery/no power', with the dead-battery clamp VCLAMPH 0.85 to 2.18 V at VDD = 0 and VBUS = 0. Section 7.6: it runs from VDD 2.7 to 5.5 V or from VBUS and moves between them; VBUS absolute maximum is 28 V. It reports over the TCPCI I2C registers with the ALERT_N open-drain interrupt, so it needs a TCPM in firmware, as P2's FUSB302BMPX does. Tamb is -40 to 85 degC. JLCPCB exact match C2674062 stockCount 600, canPresaleNumber 581, expand (12:31:24Z). NXP status: not read; the nxp.com part and product pages give no status in the page body (https://www.nxp.com/products/PTN5150 family page read 12:33:48Z shows only schema.org availability). Digi-Key (12:35:09Z): 7272 cut tape, Active, 30 weeks. Further CC and PD sink families found in jlcparts and not qualified here, with JLCPCB exact-match stock at 12:31:19Z to 12:31:24Z: TPS25730SRSMR C22390380 (833) and TPS25730DREFR C22438973 (426); TPS25750DRJKR C2868209 (325; same EEPROM boot constraint as TPS25751); TPS26750SRSMR C42166327 (167); CYPD3177-24LQXQ C2959321 (113, presale 57); AP33772DKZ-13 C5244513 (80); PI5USB30213AXEAEX C521640 (2388; Diodes data sheet URL answered 404 and 500 at 12:33:57Z and 12:34:11Z); UTC2000T-I/MG C625035 (100); STUSB1602AQTR C713192 (92); STUSB1600AQTR C2156023 (60).

Partly qualified; not read at Digi-Key because not every value is confirmed. Data sheet SLUS928B, March 2009, revised July 2016 (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/bq3060.pdf, read 2026-09-29T12:27:38Z). It is a 2S to 4S CEDV gauge and protector. VCx are 'sense voltage input terminal and external cell balancing drive output', with RBAL_drive 5.7, 3.7, 1.75 and 0.85 kOhm internal pull-downs that switch an external bypass FET (7.1.8.3). The bypass current is set by the external FET and resistor. The design note SLUA509 was not read, so the 43 mA of V142 is not shown. The 2-cell configuration shorts VC1 to VC2 and VC3. BAT supply minimum is 3.8 V, and VSTARTUP at PACK is 5.2 to 5.5 V, both under the 6.0 V floor. TOPR is -40 to 85 degC. It drives P-channel high-side protection FETs, not N-channel; its protection thresholds are in TRM SLUU319B, which was not read. JLCPCB exact match C544448 stockCount 2174, canPresaleNumber 2174 (12:29:00Z). TI meta status ACTIVE (12:29:51Z).

exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: PTN5150A Rev. 1 states no dead-battery Rd (https://www.nxp.com/docs/en/data-sheet/PTN5150A.pdf, read 2026-09-29T09:53:16Z)
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: The same data sheet, PTN5150A Rev. 1 of 9 December 2016, re-read from the same URL at 2026-09-29T12:32:54Z, states dead-battery Rd in section 7.1: 'When there is no power supplied to PTN5150A, device role (with internal pull-down resistor Rd active) will be the default configuration.' No resistance figure is given for the unpowered state; P2 accepted TUSB321RWBR with the same gap. Powered, Rd is 4.59 to 5.61 kOhm in UFP mode. The part meets the other values. In UFP role it detects the host's Rp current modes, Default, 1.5 A and 3.0 A (Table 6). It reports them in the I2C register with INTB, or on OUT1/OUT2 in non-I2C mode ('OUT1/2 reports the detected Rp pull up current source value'). VDD is 2.7 to 5.5 V with a 6.0 V absolute maximum, so it runs from VBUS directly. Tamb is -40 to 85 degC. JLCPCB exact match C2651889 stockCount 10315, canPresaleNumber 10307 (12:33:09Z). NXP status: not read; https://www.nxp.com/products/PTN5150 (12:33:48Z) carries only schema.org availability 'BackOrder' in its body. Digi-Key (12:35:06Z): 378 cut tape, Active, 30 weeks.
